svg.title: Animated examples for 18 of OmniRoute's 20 combo routing strategies. The cache-optimized and quota-weighted strategies are documented in the adjacent routing table.
svg.desc: Animated grid of 18 routing-strategy tiles; static tracks show each flow on the first frame while a small dot repeatedly travels the path each illustrated strategy takes. Light and dark follow the viewer's color scheme.
svg.text: ● request → ▮ targets — each tile animates the path its strategy takes · green outline = the pick

g.text: fill T1’s quota, then move on
